info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Wholesale Trading Trading Model-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Model Creation API enables businesses to develop and configure new trading models specifically for wholesale trading environments. This endpoint allows users to define parameters, rules, and characteristics of trading models to enhance operational effectiveness in trading strategies. Typical consumers include trading firms and financial institutions looking to innovate their trading approaches. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their model creation process, ensuring compliance with trading regulations and responsiveness to market changes.

post.summary: Create a new trading model for wholesale trading.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new trading model tailored for wholesale trading operations. A trading model defines specific strategies and rules for trading effectively within a wholesale context. Ensure that all required parameters are provided in the request body to successfully generate the model.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to create or modify trading models in the wholesale trading system. Ensure that the data adheres to the defined schema for successful processing.
